A '''Technical Branch Outpost''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] installation under the purview of the [[Tech (Imperial Intelligence)|Tech]] branch of the [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|outposts]] on [[Lotide]] and [[Dakot Seven]].
